Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at a location that has no inactive parts at all, such as a newly created location.
  • Create an active part, part A, at that location for this test.
  • Start on that location's Inventory page, on the Active tab, with the Search box empty and Bin Location and Category set to All.

Setup

  1. Make a new location: Click the box at the top right, then Settings, then Locations in the left menu, then New Location. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425591 LOCATION NEW in Name *. Click Save & Close. To switch to it: click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick it.
  2. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425591 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425591-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00. Click Save.
